About

I’m a B.Tech CSE (Internet of Things) student at SISTec, Bhopal (2023–2027) who enjoys building complete systems, from the sensor and microcontroller to the backend, database and web dashboard. I work with Python, Java and JavaScript, have built full-stack projects with Flask, MongoDB, MySQL and React, and trained a CNN for medical image classification. Alongside software, I was Co-Lead of the Electronics & IoT Team in our Robotics Club (3rd year), working hands-on with ESP32, sensors and actuators, and I won 1st place in a Robo Race. I’m looking for software, IoT and robotics roles where I can ship real products and keep learning.
